name: RTLSDR-Airband
description: This container runs an Icecast audio server that RTLSDR-Airband can connect to so that you can use an RTLSDR dongle to listen to Air Traffic Control VHF radio communications, as well as some additional kinds of NFM modulated transmissions (see NFM) via a web browser or audio playback program.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Gain
variables.description: Gain to use for the RTLSDR

variables.name: RTLSDR - Correction
variables.description: Use this if your dongle has a non-zero frequency tuning error, which requires correcting. Put correction value in ppm here. If the dongle tunes too high, this value shall be positive, negative otherwise.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Serial
variables.description: Used to have rtlsdr-airband use the correct dongle if more than one present. Enter the serial of the dongle to be used. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Mode
variables.description: If you are tuning a single frequency, set multichannel. If you are tuning more than one, set as scan

variables.name: RTLSDR - Frequency
variables.description: If you are setting multichannel for your mode, enter a single frequency. If you are setting mode as scan, enter a comma separated list of frequencies you want to scan.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Stream Name
variables.description: Name of the stream

variables.name: RTLSDR - Stream Genre
variables.description: Genre of the stream

variables.name: RTLSDR - Stream Description
variables.description: Description of the stream

variables.name: RTLSDR - Show Metadata
variables.description: If not set, the Icecast server will receive updated metadata (either frequency or a specific label) of the frequency that is being received, and will show in playback clients. It might be advantageous to disable this because updated metadata will clutter up the Icecast server logs. To disable, set to any value. Not applicable to multichannel mode.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Labels
variables.description: If Show Metadata is set to true, you can set this variable to a comma separated list of labels associated with the frequencies you are listening to. If set, the metadata on the icecast server will be updated to show the label associated with the frequency that is currently being received. If not set, the Icecast metadata will be updated with the frequency.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Mount Point
variables.description: The custom part of the stream URL. Streams will be accessible at serverip:PORT/MOUNTPOINT

variables.name: Prometheus - Enable
variables.description: Set to any value to enable rtlsdr-airband generation of Prometheus formatted channel usage statistics

variables.name: Prometheus - Port
variables.description: Port for the Prometheus server to listen on

variables.name: Icecast - Disable
variables.description: Set to any value to disable Icecast functionality

variables.name: Icecast - Hostname
variables.description: Icecast hostname

variables.name: Icecast - Admin Username
variables.description: Icecast admin username

variables.name: Icecast - Admin Password
variables.description: Icecast admin password

variables.name: Icecast - Admin Email
variables.description: Icecast admin email

variables.name: Icecast - Location
variables.description: Icecast location

variables.name: RTLSDR - Build Platform
variables.description: On the container's first run, the rtl_airband binary will be built with platform-specific optimisation if this is set. It can be set to rpiv2, generic or native

variables.name: RTLSDR - Radio Type
variables.description: Type of dongle that is providing the radio tuning

variables.name: RTLSDR - Log Scanned Activity
variables.description: rtlsdr-airband can output what frequencies it has received traffic on. Set this to any non-blank value to enable

variables.name: RTLSDR - FFT Size
variables.description: This value controls the general audio quality. A larger value means increased CPU usage. Accepted values are powers of two in the range of 256-8192, inclusive.

variables.name: RTLSDR - Sample Rate
variables.description: Set the sample rate of the audio stream.

variables.name: RTLSDR - NFM Support
variables.description: Set to any value to build the rtl_airband binary with NFM support.

variables.name: Icecast - Max Clients
variables.description: Max Icecast listeners

variables.name: Icecast - Max Sources
variables.description: Maximum number of clients that can provide a stream to the Icecast server

devices.name: RTLSDR - Dongle
devices.description: USB device to use for the RTLSDR
